how_to_apply: Pay the non-refundable application fee through online transfer to the bank account of IIIT Kalyani (Account Name: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Kalyani, Bank Name: State Bank of India, Account No: 33984361509, IFSC Code: SBIN0006701, MICR Code: 700002332).
Note the reference number of the bank transaction to include in the application form.
Prepare the application form and ensure it is duly signed and completed in all respects.
Prepare a research proposal with clear objectives, outcomes, and deliverables along with all necessary documents.

Send the hard copy of the application form and documents by post to: The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Kalyani, IIIT/A-23, WARD NO.18, KALYANI, NADIA-741235 (ON KALYANI BARRACKPORE EXPRESSWAY). Ensure the hard copy reaches the address on or before 22.10.2026.
Send the softcopy of the application and documents by email to [email protected] on or before 22.10.2026.
important_instructions: Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not ensure an applicant’s right to join as PDF. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the position if no candidate is found suitable. The post is purely on a contractual and temporary basis. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. Applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. Temporary position holders in academia or research must relinquish their current roles if selected. Applicants who completed their PhD from IIIT Kalyani are not eligible. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the date of interview by e-mail.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Kalyani Post Doctoral Fellow Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The institute has announced a total of 1 vacancy for the Post Doctoral Fellow position under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Phase II.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Kalyani Post Doctoral Fellow Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible Indian Nationals. The candidate should have proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions. PDF applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions would be considered, but they would be required to relinquish their current roles if selected for the fellowship. Preference would be given to PDF applicants who have active industry linkages and their research proposal is directed towards industry specific problems.

rows.qualification_required: Candidate with Ph.D degree with the research domain focusing Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) or IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). The applicant must have obtained a PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. The applicant should have completed PhD within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application. Applicants should not have completed their PhD from IIIT Kalyani.

content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application.
